seo.title: Packers & Oregon Ducks Watch Bar in Mission Beach | Miss B's
seo.description: Watch Green Bay Packers and Oregon Ducks games at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach, San Diego. TVs inside and outside, food, cocktails and a wraparound patio.

intro.imageAlt: Green Bay Packers fans toasting at Miss B's Coconut Club entrance Mission Beach San Diego
intro.heading:
Mission Beach's Home
for Game Day
body: Miss B's Coconut Club is Mission Beach's official watch party headquarters for Green Bay Packers and Oregon Ducks fans. Watch on TVs throughout the bar and wraparound patio at 3704 Mission Blvd.
Game day specials, tropical cocktails, cold beer, and the open-air vibe that makes every kickoff feel like a celebration. Walk-ins welcome — reservations recommended for big games.

feature.imageAlt: Green Bay Packers fans cheering at Miss B's Coconut Club Mission Beach San Diego
feature.heading:
Every Game,
Every Season
feature.body: We show every Green Bay Packers and Oregon Ducks game — regular season, playoffs, and championship runs. Come early, grab your spot, and celebrate every play with the Mission Beach crowd.
